title: land's wait-merge names a merge request stuck in GitLab's preparing state and its close-and-reopen remedy
goal: While land --wait-merge waits, it reads the request's detailed_merge_status, and a request still preparing after a few minutes (no diff refs, no pipeline) is named with the remedy that merged it (close and reopen the request, then backlog.py merge), instead of waiting out the whole timeout
notes: SP-ofvvong6 retrospective: ST-e6bueg2y wait-merge exit=1 after 1881 s (ops 2026-10-14T16:36Z); merge requests 1055 and 1056 sat in detailed_merge_status preparing with no diff refs and no pipeline; backlog.py merge got 405 then 422, the rebase API 500; closing and reopening each request made it mergeable within a minute.
